candidateClaims.subject: taijifu
candidateClaims.claim: TAIJIFU evolved through multiple martial arts.
candidateClaims.promotionRequirement: Explicit creator ruling or stable source locator identifying the supported martial influences and, if claimed, their chronology.

guardrails: Do not infer martial influences from similarity of technique or terminology.
Do not convert Masters/game mechanics into historical martial provenance.
Do not assign dates, order, teachers, schools or lineages without explicit evidence.
An influence may be canonical even when its exact date is unresolved, provided the influence itself has explicit provenance.
